title: ChargeOps 관제 (통합)
description: 2026-10-14 시안 D2 — 관제 · 우리 vs 제주 · 운영 감사를 한 화면에. 색 규칙: 빨강 고장·긴급 / 노랑 주의·통신 이상 / 파랑 충전·승인 대기 / 초록 정상·해소 / 회색 모름 / 청록 우리

panels.title: 끊김 · 고장 충전기
panels.description: 연결이 끊겼거나 고장(Faulted)인 실물 충전기 수. 어느 충전기인지는 아래 카드에서 확인

targets.expr: count((max by (charger_id) (chargeops_charger_connected{charger_id=~"CH-.*"}) == 0) or (max by (charger_id) (chargeops_charger_faulted{charger_id=~"CH-.*"}) == 1)) or vector(0)

panels.title: 공공 API 수집 · 마지막 성공
panels.description: 5분마다 도는 제주 상태 수집이 마지막으로 성공한 지 몇 분. 11분 넘으면 노랑(2회 연속 실패), 30분 넘으면 빨강

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(extract(epoch FROM now() - max(started_at)) / 60)::int AS v FROM collect_log WHERE operation = 'getChargerStatus' AND status = 'ok'

panels.title: DB 복제 지연
panels.description: Standby(db-02)가 Primary 보다 몇 초 늦은지. 5초 노랑 · 30초 빨강

panels.title: 알림 전송 실패 · 1시간
panels.description: Slack · 메일 전송 실패 수. 0 이 아니면 알림이 사람에게 닿지 않았을 수 있음 — 감사 줄의 '알림 전송 실패' 표

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS v FROM v_ops_notify WHERE sent_at > now() - interval '1 hour' AND channel IN ('slack', 'mail') AND status <> 'ok'

panels.title: 백업 · WAL 보관
panels.description: Primary 의 WAL 이 S3 로 마지막 보관된 지 몇 초 (평소 60초 안). 5분 노랑 · 15분 빨강

panels.title: 조치 필요 — 급한 순 · '무슨 일'을 누르면 Slack 스레드
panels.description: 열린 장애(긴급 · 높음 · 주의)와 대기 중인 승인 요청. 담당 = Slack 에서 처음 버튼을 누른 사람

targets.rawSql:
SELECT level AS "등급", target AS "대상", title AS "무슨 일", detail AS "상황", owner AS "담당",
  CASE WHEN age_sec < 3600 THEN to_char(make_interval(secs => age_sec), 'MI:SS') ELSE to_char(make_interval(secs => age_sec), 'HH24:MI:SS') END AS "경과",
  slack_permalink AS link
FROM v_ops_todo ORDER BY prio, detected_at

panels.title: $charger
panels.description: 상태 · 전압(노랑) · 전류(주황) · 온도(빨강 글자, 55 ℃ 주의 · 60 ℃ 경고) · 이상 점수(0.6 주의 · 0.8 경고) · 오늘 가동률. 전압 · 전류는 최근 10분 안 최신 측정값

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.state AS "상태", m.voltage_v AS "전압", m.current_a * 1000 AS "전류", c.temp_c::float AS "온도", c.anomaly::float AS "이상 점수", c.uptime_today::float AS "오늘 가동" FROM v_charger_card c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.voltage_v, s.current_a FROM meter_sample s WHERE s.charger_id = c.charger_id AND s.ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' ORDER BY s.ts DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true WHERE c.charger_id = '$charger'

panels.title: $charger · 30분 흐름
panels.description: 주황 실선 = 전류(왼쪽 축 0~3 mA, 넘으면 자동 확장, 부하를 꽂고 빼면 계단) · 빨강 점선 = 온도(오른쪽 축 15~45 ℃)

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, current_a * 1000 AS "전류" FROM meter_sample WHERE charger_id = '$charger' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 공공 API · 오늘 호출 / 한도 1,000
panels.description: 공공데이터포털 인증키 하루 한도. 5분 수집이면 하루 약 289회. 700 노랑 · 900 빨강

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(api_calls), 0) AS "오늘 호출" FROM collect_log WHERE started_at >= date_trunc('day', now())

SELECT CASE WHEN status = 'ok' THEN '성공' ELSE '실패' END AS "결과", rows_fetched AS "받은 건수", rows_loaded AS "변경", to_char(started_at, 'HH24:MI') AS "시각" FROM collect_log WHERE operation = 'getChargerStatus' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') AS "성공", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok') AS "실패" FROM collect_log WHERE started_at >= date_trunc('day', now())

panels.title: 공공 API · 24시간 수집 (5분 단위)
panels.description: 초록 = 수집됨 · 회색 = 빈 시간(VM 꺼짐 등, 그 시간의 상태 변화는 복구 불가) · 빨강 = 실패

targets.rawSql:
SELECT b AS time,
  CASE WHEN bool_or(l.status = 'ok') THEN 1 WHEN count(l.started_at) > 0 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS "수집"
FROM generate_series(date_trunc('hour', now() - interval '24 hours'), now(), interval '5 minutes') b
LEFT JOIN collect_log l ON l.operation = 'getChargerStatus' AND l.started_at >= b AND l.started_at < b + interval '5 minutes'
GROUP BY b ORDER BY b

panels.title: 제주 공공 충전기 — 문제만 밝게 (참고용 · 우리가 조치할 대상 아님)
panels.description: 흐린 초록 = 대기 · 충전 중, 노랑 = 통신 이상, 빨강 = 고장 · 운영중지 · 점검중. 점 위에 마우스를 올리면 충전소 이름

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.lat AS latitude, s.lng AS longitude, fn_status_group(cur.status_code) AS "상태", c.charger_id AS "충전기", s.name AS "충전소"
FROM charger_status_current cur JOIN charger c USING (charger_id) JOIN station s USING (station_id)
WHERE s.region_code = '50' AND c.source = 'public' AND s.lat IS NOT NULL AND fn_status_group(cur.status_code) IN ('대기', '충전 중')

SELECT s.lat AS latitude, s.lng AS longitude, fn_status_group(cur.status_code) AS "상태", c.charger_id AS "충전기", s.name AS "충전소", cs.name AS "세부 상태"
FROM charger_status_current cur JOIN charger c USING (charger_id) JOIN station s USING (station_id) JOIN code_status cs ON cs.code = cur.status_code
WHERE s.region_code = '50' AND c.source = 'public' AND s.lat IS NOT NULL AND fn_status_group(cur.status_code) IN ('통신 이상', '고장·중지')

panels.title: 이용 가능률 — 우리 vs 제주
panels.description: 지금 이용 가능한(고장 · 통신이상 · 운영중지 · 점검중이 아닌) 충전기 비율. 제주는 상태를 모르는 충전기 제외

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
 (SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT cs.is_down) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) FROM charger c JOIN charger_status_current cur USING (charger_id) JOIN code_status cs ON cs.code = cur.status_code WHERE c.source = 'model' AND NOT c.is_deleted) AS "우리",
 (SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT cs.is_down) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) FROM charger c JOIN charger_status_current cur USING (charger_id) JOIN code_status cs ON cs.code = cur.status_code JOIN station s USING (station_id) WHERE s.region_code = '50' AND c.source = 'public' AND cur.status_code NOT IN ('0', '9')) AS "제주 평균"

panels.title: 지금 상태 분포 (%) — 같은 색 · 같은 순서

targets.rawSql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN c.source = 'model' THEN '우리' ELSE '제주' END AS g, fn_status_group(cur.status_code) AS st
  FROM charger_status_current cur JOIN charger c USING (charger_id) JOIN station s USING (station_id)
  WHERE (s.region_code = '50' AND c.source = 'public') OR (c.source = 'model' AND NOT c.is_deleted))
SELECT g AS "구분",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE st = '대기') / count(*), 1) AS "대기",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE st = '충전 중') / count(*), 1) AS "충전 중",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE st = '통신 이상') / count(*), 1) AS "통신 이상",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE st = '고장·중지') / count(*), 1) AS "고장·중지",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE st = '모름') / count(*), 1) AS "모름"
FROM t GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

SELECT count(*) AS "해소", round(avg(resolve_sec))::int AS "MTTR · 평균 처리",
 (SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ok') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) FROM v_ops_notify WHERE sent_at >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND channel IN ('slack', 'mail')) AS "알림 전송"
FROM v_ops_incidents WHERE resolved_at >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND severity <> 'SEV4'

SELECT to_char(resolved_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "해소", coalesce(charger_id, '-') AS "충전기", title AS "무슨 일", coalesce(owner, '자동 회복') AS "담당",
  CASE WHEN resolve_sec < 60 THEN resolve_sec || '초' WHEN resolve_sec < 3600 THEN resolve_sec / 60 || '분 ' || resolve_sec % 60 || '초' ELSE resolve_sec / 3600 || '시간 ' || resolve_sec % 3600 / 60 || '분' END AS "소요"
FROM v_ops_incidents WHERE status = 'resolved' AND severity <> 'SEV4' ORDER BY resolved_at DESC LIMIT 5

panels.title: 추세 — 7일 가동률 · 이상 점수 · 제주 운영기관
일 가동률 — 우리 vs 제주 평균 (%)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.day::timestamptz AS time, CASE WHEN c.source = 'model' THEN '우리' ELSE '제주 평균' END AS metric, round(avg(m.uptime_pct), 2) AS value
FROM mv_daily_uptime m JOIN charger c USING (charger_id) JOIN station s USING (station_id)
WHERE (s.region_code = '50' AND c.source = 'public') OR c.source = 'model'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: 모형 충전기를 밤에 꺼 두는 시간도 다운으로 계산 (예: 10/22 CH-02 19:09 통신이상 → 다음 날 09:01 복귀). 실제 장애 시간은 MTTR 패널 참고

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, charger_id AS metric, score FROM v_anomaly_score WHERE charger_id LIKE 'CH-%' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) ORDER BY 1

SELECT coalesce(o.name, s.operator_id) AS "운영기관", count(*) AS "충전기",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE cs.is_down) AS "다운", count(*) FILTER (WHERE cur.status_code = '3') AS "충전 중",
  round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT cs.is_down) / count(*), 1) AS "이용 가능률"
FROM charger_status_current cur JOIN charger c USING (charger_id) JOIN station s USING (station_id)
JOIN code_status cs ON cs.code = cur.status_code LEFT JOIN operator o ON o.operator_id = s.operator_id
WHERE s.region_code = '50' AND c.source = 'public' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 감사 — 조치 이력 · 역할 · 알림 전송 실패
조치 이력 — 누가 · 언제 · 무엇을 · 결과 (선택한 기간)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(created_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "시각", who AS "누가", charger_id AS "충전기", what AS "무엇을", result AS "결과", coalesce(approved_by, '') AS "승인", reason AS "사유"
FROM v_ops_actions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY action_id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT name AS "이름", role AS "역할", to_char(valid_from, 'MM-DD') AS "부여일", granted_by AS "준 사람" FROM v_ops_roles ORDER BY CASE role WHEN 'Admin' THEN 1 WHEN 'Lead' THEN 2 WHEN 'Operator' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, name
SELECT to_char(sent_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "시각", channel AS "채널", incident_id AS "장애", detail AS "오류" FROM v_ops_notify WHERE status <> 'ok' AND $__timeFilter(sent_at) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: 백업 저장소 마지막 성공 (경과)
panels.description: pgBackRest repo별로 마지막 백업이 끝난 뒤 지난 시간. repo1 = MinIO(s3.chargeops.lab), repo2 = AWS S3. 매일 03:40 백업이라 26시간을 넘으면 빨간색. 값은 DB 서버 타이머(chargeops-backup-status, 10분마다)가 backup_repo_status 표에 저장함.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(extract(epoch FROM now() - last_stop)) FILTER (WHERE repo = 1) AS "repo1 (MinIO)", max(extract(epoch FROM now() - last_stop)) FILTER (WHERE repo = 2) AS "repo2 (AWS S3)" FROM backup_repo_status

panels.title: 백업 저장소별 상태
panels.description: repo별 마지막 백업(종류 · 라벨 · 끝난 시각 · 크기)과 결과. result가 error면 pgBackRest가 그 백업에 오류를 표시한 것. repo status에 error가 보이면 pgbackrest info 자체가 실패한 것.

targets.rawSql: SELECT repo_name AS "repo", last_type AS "type", last_label AS "label", last_stop AS "finished", round(size_bytes / 1048576.0, 1) AS "size MB", CASE WHEN last_error THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END AS "result", repo_status AS "repo status", checked_at AS "checked" FROM backup_repo_status ORDER BY repo

panels.title: 데이터 품질 점수 (최근 · 7항목 평균)
panels.description: 매일 02:00 dq-job 이 전날 데이터를 7항목(누락·중복·이상값 등)으로 점검

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(score) * 100, 1) AS "품질 점수" FROM dq_result WHERE check_date = (SELECT max(check_date) FROM dq_result)

panels.title: MTTR 중앙값 (7일)
panels.description: 긴 장애 1건에 흔들리지 않게 7일 일별 MTTR 의 중앙값으로 표시 (실물 모형 기준)

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY mttr_min)::numeric, 1) AS "MTTR 중앙값(분)" FROM stat_operator_daily WHERE mttr_min IS NOT NULL AND day >= current_date - 7

panels.title: MTTR — 우리 충전기 (일별, 분)
panels.description: 실물 모형(CH-01~03)에서 해소된 장애 기준. 10/21 은 밤사이 통신 두절 1건(891분)이 포함돼 크게 튐

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, mttr_min AS "MTTR(분)", fault_cnt AS "고장 수" FROM stat_operator_daily WHERE mttr_min IS NOT NULL AND day >= current_date - 14 ORDER BY 1
